facilities.name: Toalett, Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Tourist toilet in the old fälängan. Listed as open 24h May-October with variation. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 13; dedupe by source URL/coordinate.

facilities.name: Vatten, Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Drinking water at the Lövstabruk toilet/fälängan service point, available May-October with opening variation. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 13.

facilities.name: Toalett, Österlövsta kyrka
facilities.description: Public toilet in a red building outside the church wall, signed from Upplandsleden. Listed as open year-round but may close for winter repair/renovation.

facilities.name: Vatten, Österlövsta kyrka
facilities.description: Drinking-water refill at the signed toilet by Österlövsta kyrka. Listed as year-round but may close for repair/renovation in winter.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Svenbo
facilities.description: Shelter/rest area in the forest, about 12 km from Lövstabruk. Ground around the shelter is uneven, but smaller tents may fit nearby; keep tenting pending rather than importing a formal campsite.

facilities.name: Eldplats, Svenbo
facilities.description: Simple fireplace at Svenbo shelter/rest area. Current Naturkartan notice says there is no firewood at Svenbo, so hikers should not rely on supplied wood.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Svenbo
facilities.description: Rest area in the forest at Svenbo, same physical cluster as the shelter and fireplace.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Västland
facilities.description: Shelter by Tämnarån near Hembygdsgården. It is a short signed detour/spur from Upplandsleden and is shared endpoint context with Etapp 15.

facilities.name: Eldplats, Västland
facilities.description: Fireplace at the Västland shelter/rest area by Tämnarån. Apply current fire-ban and grass/forest fire-risk guidance.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Västland
facilities.description: Rest area at the Västland shelter beside Tämnarån, reached by the signed spur near Hembygdsgården.

facilities.name: Vatten, Västlands kyrka
facilities.description: Tap by the parish house at Västlands kyrka, to the right of the smaller entrance. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 15.

facilities.name: Toalett, Västlands kyrka
facilities.description: Public toilet on the cemetery/church grounds, signed from the trail. Listed as year-round but may close for winter repair/renovation. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 15.

facilities.name: Lövstabruk bruksmiljö
facilities.description: Historic ironworks/manor environment at the stage start. Shared endpoint POI with Etapp 13; keep one heritage POI rather than separate rows for each visitor attraction.

facilities.name: Österlövsta kyrka
facilities.description: Church environment by Strömarån. Tierp municipality describes the Österlövsta church setting as a major church environment, with the present church originating in 1451 and older church/cemetery remains nearby.

facilities.name: Barsjön och gammeltallarna
facilities.description: Route-feature POI for the small forest lake Barsjön and old pines on its west side, described in official route prose. Coordinate is snapped to GPX near the lake and should be refined if a discrete marker is found.
